comparison.objective: Peel a sterile pouch, deliver forceps onto a drape without contamination, discard the sheets, and withdraw; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Pouch task tests bimanual tab grasping, peel-force coordination, controlled gravity release, contamination avoidance, and waste placement; candidate tests rigid small-tool use, collar tuning, locking, and dynamic inspection.
comparison.success_condition: Pouch task latches zero on specified contamination and requires ≥12 mm peel, sterile delivery, disposal, and arm return; candidate requires safe impact cycles and measured setting retention.
comparison.reason: Sterile transfer and peeling test unrelated abilities. Missing rubric details: the pouch film and seal are rigid/switch-mode approximations, explicitly disclosed.
